transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

Hi. Um... I'm just having trouble getting things done, I guess. I keep getting pulled off track by... well, just every little sound or thought. Like, I'll be trying to work on an application, and then... a car drives by outside, or my phone lights up, or I just get some random idea. And then I'm off doing something else before I even notice it. So... yeah. That's mostly why I'm here.
Can you tell me more about how easily you get distracted? For example, does this happen even when you're trying really hard to focus, or only when you're not interested in what you're doing?

Um... I mean, like I was just saying, it's... it's really just every little sound or thought. Even if I'm trying hard to finish that application. It doesn't really matter. A car outside, or my phone, or... just some random idea in my head. I just get pulled off track before I even notice I stopped working. So... yeah.
Can you describe if these distractions happen even when you're in a quiet environment or when you're doing something that usually interests you a lot?
Um... I don't know. I guess it happens when it's quiet, too. My thoughts just kind of wander off. And if it's something I like... I'm not really sure. I just know I have a hard time staying on track.
Can you tell me if you still find yourself getting distracted even when you're in a quiet room with no outside noises or interruptions?
Um... yeah. Like I said... it still happens. Even if there's no noise, I just... get lost in my own head, I guess. I don't really know what else to say about it.
